name: Sidekicks THC Mints - Cinnamon Spark
description: Designed for consumers looking for a micro-dose option, the 2.5mg sugar-free Sidekicks THC Mints are the perfect size for a quick way to relax when you're on the move. Each pack contains 50 mints for a total of 125mg of THC.
